l.i: contingens dividunt totam entis amplitudinem. O-
mne enim ens est vel necessarium vel contingens.
Quæ autem dividunt totum ens, illa non coincidunt
in ullum ens, seeus non dividerent totum ens. Resp.

main_text.l: I. Præter aliquid Sophistici acuminis, ausim
dicere, nihil fuisse in impostore isto præter
fumos & verba, imò ne umbratilem logicæ
aut metaphysicæ notitiam. Age itaque
Iacobe, fare quæso, an non causa vel causatum, po-
tentia vel actus, finitum infinitum dividunt
totum ens? Omne enim ens est causa vel cau-
satum, actus vel potentia, finitum vel infini-
tum, & tamen materia prima, elementa, &
ferè omnia entia sunt causa respectu aliorum
entium, & causatum respectu primæ causæ,
elementa sunt actu elementa & mista in poten-
tia, Embryo actu Embryo, & potentia homo.

page.notes: The first word of the page is cut off at the left edge; "ecedenter" is kept as a fragment, probably "accedenter". "id quem" is read as printed, though the left edge is clipped. The marginal notes are placed beside the nearest text line, which is approximate. The signature "H 5" and the catchword "Sophi-" are printed at the foot.
